caption:
Instagram does not demote content created in other apps, as long as there's no watermark. Mosseri said it on October 30, 2026.

This one has been garbled for years into "editing outside Instagram kills your reach", and it sent a lot of people back to editing inside the app with worse tools and worse results.

The actual rule is narrow and it makes sense: Instagram doesn't want to recommend content that's visibly an export from a competitor. The TikTok watermark is the problem. The editor is not.

So edit wherever your work is best. CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, your phone, whatever. Then export clean — no watermark, no border, no muted audio track.

Four things Instagram names as reach-limited and people ignore: watermarked, muted, bordered, and majority-text Reels. Check your export settings against that list once and you'll never think about it again.

Use the better tool. Just don't let it sign your work for you.
